messages:
leila: Quick shadow summary for v2p2-int4: ~10% token cost down, ~55% throughput up on p4-small. But long-doc MRR 78.4 -> 76.6 (-1.8 abs). legal hallucination +0.7% abs. p99 +2ms. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
omar: which slices drive the MRR drop?
leila: short: general -0.3 abs; long-docs (>8k) -1.8 abs (N=4200, 95% CI [-2.4, -1.2]); code +0.1; legal halluc +0.7 (N=1200, p=0.02).
nina: legal p=0.02 is worrying. sample sizes ok but still borderline.
shawn: recommend block automated promote >5% until we run warm-KV burn-in or adjust quant kernels.
omar: agree. suspect KV-cache warmup + int4 interaction. propose warm-kv shadow and targeted long-doc fuzz (5k samples).
eval-bot: eval job created: ev-175900-01 tracking [mrr, hallucination_rate, exact_match, p95/p99].
sre-bot: note: draft canary config added to repo (short): phases [1%,5%,20%], min_samples 2k, MRR abs/rel thresholds, hallucination abs threshold, auto-fallback on 2 consecutive windows.
leila: action items: 1) run warm-kv shadow (me), 2) long-doc burn-in (me), 3) implement canary CI thresholds (shawn), 4) soft-degrade route (omar). Wait for ev-175900-01 before promoting.
shawn: TL;DR block auto-promote until long-doc CI narrows or delta <0.5 abs. manual tiny canary ok with rerank soft-degrade. :thumbsup:
